name: 1354 Pentair FRP Vessel
summary: The Pentair 1354 FRP Pressure Vessel is a high-performance, top-open pressure vessel designed for water treatment applications such as water softeners, sand filters, activated carbon filters, and multimedia filtration systems.
intro: The Pentair 1354 FRP Pressure Vessel is a premium-quality fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) pressure vessel engineered for residential, commercial, and industrial water treatment systems. Designed with a 13-inch diameter and 54-inch height, this top-open vessel is ideal for use in water softeners, activated carbon filters, multimedia filters, sand filters, and other filtration applications.
benefits: Water Softener, Sand Filter, Activated Carbon Filter, Multimedia Filter, Industrial Water Treatment
